mods.name: ShokiMod
mods.description: Hypixel Skyblock mod: rare loot alerts with designable banners, fusion/craft/forge profit screens, mining and pet HUDs, mob markers, critter safari helpers and chat rules with custom sounds. Fork of GanKura by GanKuraDee; CREDITS.md names every borrowed feature and its source mod.
